primitives.note: Martial Cadence adds bonus physical damage to every basic attack, gated by an internal per-target cooldown that scales by champion level (6s→3s).
Martial Cadence's bonus damage is 8% of the target's current health, floored at 20 and capped at 400 vs non-champions.
Q deals damage on a 0.4s cast, E deals damage on cast with no cast time, R deals damage on impact after a 0.35s leap.
Dragon Strike shreds the target's armor by 10-26% for 3 seconds, applied after the initial hit's own damage.
Deployed flag grants an attack-speed aura (equal to the passive %) to Jarvan while near it for the flag's 8s duration, plus Jarvan's own permanent passive attack-speed bonus.
Passive permanent attack speed stacks additively with the deployed flag's aura attack speed (up to double the listed value); multiple flags' auras do not stack with each other.
Cataclysm has an initial leap+damage+terrain-creation part and an optional manual recast (after 0.75s) that destroys the terrain; both count as ability activations for on-cast effects.
Golden Aegis deals no damage; it only slows enemies and shields Jarvan, relevant to the survival fight, not the damage fight.

needsBespoke.why: Every damage-relevant mechanic (onhit rider with health-based cap/floor, plain-cast burst damage, armor shred debuff, an attack-speed aura/passive stacking rule, and a recastable ultimate) maps onto existing primitives; nothing requires bespoke logic beyond combining them.

unsettled.question: If Dragon Strike is cast more than once during the 15s fight (its cooldown of 6-10s allows this), does the second cast's armor-shred refresh/overwrite the first application, stack additively, or simply reapply the same debuff with no additional effect?
options: Refreshes duration/magnitude to the latest cast's value (no stacking)
Stacks additively with the prior instance
Second application is redundant since duration (3s) is shorter than the cooldown and rarely overlaps
quotes: The armor reduction is applied after the damage. The damage dealt does not benefit from it in this case.

unsettled.question: Should the simulator assume Jarvan maintains continuous attack-speed-aura uptime from a deployed Demacian Standard flag throughout the 15s fight, or should uptime be gated realistically by the flag's 8s duration versus its ~10-12s (rank-dependent) recast cooldown, leaving gaps where only the base passive AS applies?
options: Assume 100% uptime (always standing in aura range with a flag active)
Model actual uptime windows based on E's cooldown vs the flag's 8s duration, leaving gaps between casts
Assume the flag is only up during the opening cast and never recast within 15s
quotes: '''Jarvan IV''' gains a total of {{ap|20*2 to 30*2}}% bonus attack speed from ''Demacian Standard'' while near the flag.
The flag then remains for 8 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and providing an {{tip|aura}}

unsettled.question: Dragon Strike's description says Jarvan can cast any ability during its dash, but it is unclear whether basic attacks can also be issued (and land) during the 0.4s cast + subsequent dash animation, which affects how many total auto-attacks (and thus Martial Cadence procs) fit into the 15s window.
options: Basic attacks queue/land normally during the Q cast and dash with no lost attack time
The dash briefly blocks attack commands, costing a small amount of attack uptime each Q cast
quotes: '''''Jarvan IV''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

proposal: Open with Dragon Strike (Q) on the dummy for immediate physical damage and to apply the armor shred before other physical damage lands.
Follow immediately with Cataclysm (R) on the dummy so its large physical-damage burst benefits from the reduced armor from Q.
Cast Demacian Standard (E) at the dummy's location for magic damage and to gain the attack-speed aura/passive bonus for the rest of the fight.
Auto-attack continuously between and after ability casts, letting Martial Cadence proc its bonus current-health-based physical damage on its internal cooldown.
Recast Dragon Strike (Q) every time it comes off cooldown (6-10s by rank) for repeated physical damage and to keep the armor shred active.
Recast Demacian Standard (E) every time it comes off cooldown (~10-12s) to add more magic damage and refresh the attack-speed aura.
Do not cast Golden Aegis (W) in the damage-fight rotation, since it deals no damage and only provides a shield/slow relevant to the survival fight.
Do not manually recast Cataclysm to destroy the terrain unless it is free of downside, since the recast itself adds no damage.
questions: Is the dummy always within Cataclysm's 650-unit target range and Dragon Strike's dash/aoe range so R and Q can be cast on cooldown without repositioning delay?

At what champion level and item build is this rotation intended to be evaluated, since Martial Cadence's proc cooldown (3-6s) and Demacian Standard's rank both change how much value auto-attack weaving contributes?

Should Q be assumed to hit a pre-placed Demacian Standard flag (triggering the dash/knockup with no extra damage) as part of optimal play, or is that interaction irrelevant to the damage fight and should be ignored?

Is R best opened immediately at the start of the fight (for its long cooldown to begin ticking down early) even before Q's armor shred is up, trading some R damage for more total R casts over a longer window, or is a single 15s fight short enough that R's cooldown never matters and shred-before-R is strictly better?
